description: The design rules for every screen and every text of Agent Web (aweb): its two faces (the aweb app and the bb extension), the twelve rules, agents and threads, needs you, commands and keys, the voice, and how a design is made and checked. One skill, aweb-design, with its references. The briefing gives every soul that holds it the aweb voice. For the souls that design aweb and check its designs (aweb-designer, aweb-design-qa).
